name: git-switch
description: Switch this repository to an existing local branch without branch creation, remote guessing, or additional git flags.
risk_reasons: can carry uncommitted worktree changes across branches when Git allows it

branch.description: Existing local branch to switch to. Branch creation and remote guessing are intentionally not supported.

constraints: Only switches this repository, resolved relative to the template directory.
Only accepts branch names matching the reviewed branch pattern.
Does not create branches, detach HEAD, guess remote branches, or accept arbitrary git flags.
invariants: The executed command shape is always git -C .. switch --no-guess -- <branch>.
Inputs cannot inject additional git options because the branch value is a single structured argument after --.
Git itself must confirm the target is an existing local branch.
